concepts.name: Full-Stack Platform Chart
concepts.summary: Umbrella Helm chart (name online-counseling, version 2.0.2) deploying the entire ORISO platform: Keycloak, MariaDB, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Redis, Matrix/Synapse, LiveKit + MatrixRTC auth, Element Call, the nginx ingress controller, an optional SigNoz observability stack, the health dashboard, and all ORISO backend/frontend services. Infra subcharts are vendored unpacked under charts/ with file:// dependencies; service workloads are rendered directly from templates/<service>/.

concepts.name: Config/Secret Split (values.yaml + secrets.yaml)
concepts.summary: Configuration is split across two gitignored files created from tracked *.default templates: values.yaml (domain, realm, Matrix server name, image references) and secrets.yaml (all credentials). Several secrets are fail-closed at render time: agencyService.serviceEncryptionAppkey and userService.statisticsMessageCountHmacSecret make the chart refuse to render when blank, and password-reset/account-invite base URLs fail closed at runtime when unset.

concepts.name: Environment Overlays (prod-safe baseline + values-dev/values-prod)
concepts.summary: values.yaml.default is a prod-safe baseline (springProfilesActive prod, no dummy-data seeding, OTP allowed by default, encryption never toggleable). Per-environment behaviour is layered via untracked values-dev.yaml / values-prod.yaml overlays instead of separate copies; production is deployed by the hoster via ArgoCD. Overlays only change test friction and wiring — there is deliberately no dev encryption-off mode.

concepts.name: Keycloak Subchart, Custom Theme, and User Bootstrap
concepts.summary: charts/keycloak carries the realm definition (realm.json, imported on first start only), deployment templates, and the ORISO custom theme (login pages, OTP email templates, DE/EN messages, Nunito fonts) mounted via theme configmaps. The image is the ORISO-built oriso-keycloak (OTP support). A parent-chart Job bootstraps Keycloak users, and realm import on pod restart is guarded so it never re-imports destructively.

concepts.name: MariaDB Subchart: Canonical SQL Schema Mirrors
concepts.summary: Since 2026-06-30 charts/mariadb/sql-schemas/ is the canonical home of the per-service MariaDB schema mirrors (agencyservice, consultingtypeservice, tenantservice, uploadservice, userservice) — ORISO-Database is archived. Environments that force SPRING_LIQUIBASE_ENABLED=false (Pre-Dev configmap) rely on these mirrors plus manual ALTER runbooks; legacy Liquibase changelog overrides are normalized for compatibility.

concepts.name: Matrix-Only Messaging Stack (ADR-005, no legacy chat)
concepts.summary: Synapse homeserver with dedicated Postgres statefulset (including WAL-archive/PITR backup and restore scripting in its config). ADR-005 invariants are enforced: the homeserver is non-federated (empty federation_domain_whitelist), server_name must never be a bare IP (static guardrail with self-test), and a render guard bans any Rocket.Chat or embedded-Jitsi remnant from ever returning to the chart.

concepts.name: LiveKit SFU + MatrixRTC Authorization
concepts.summary: Calls run on a LiveKit SFU (hostNetwork) fronted by two MatrixRTC authorization deployments: the upstream authorization service and the ORISO policy gateway. Grants are fail-closed: every new call/reconnect is resolved against UserService using the dedicated callPolicyToken; UserService unavailability never yields a permissive grant. A bootstrap Job registers a non-admin Matrix membership-reader user and patches its access token into matrixrtc-auth-secrets. Single-node rollouts use strategy Recreate with validation errors for unsafe topologies; NetworkPolicies restrict ingress-controller and homeserver reachability.

concepts.name: Element Call Widget Deployment
concepts.summary: Element Call (ORISO-built ghcr image) is deployed as the call widget UI with its own configmap/deployment/service plus dedicated ingresses: an element-call host ingress, a main-host static-asset ingress, and a /room compatibility ingress on the main domain.

concepts.name: Single-Domain Ingress Routing
concepts.summary: The chart ships its own ingress-nginx controller and ~25 Ingress objects routing everything under one public domain: /service/* paths to backend services (main-ingress), tenant public/tenantadmin/access/id rewrites, unauthenticated GET /media/{id} to TenantService for legal-text images (epic Admin#366 WP-3a), Matrix client-server API, LiveKit SFU/JWT endpoints, Element Call, ACME, and /signoz. TenantService single-domain access flags are render-tested.

concepts.name: Digest-Pinned Cutover Release Process
concepts.summary: For the coordinated Matrix-only/Matryoshka cutover, Frontend, Element Call, UserService, AgencyService, Synapse and both MatrixRTC images accept only complete repository@sha256 digests. scripts/cutover-release-preflight.py validates a cross-repo release manifest fail-closed (STOP_SHIP placeholders, zero/wrong digests, missing PR or security evidence, forbidden legacy render artifacts) and emits the exact Helm digest overlay used between environment values and secrets.

concepts.name: Install-Time Bootstrap Jobs
concepts.summary: Helm hooks seed the platform after the schema layer is ready: a tenant bootstrap Job (tenant-bootstrap.sql), a topic bootstrap Job for ConsultingTypeService, a Keycloak user bootstrap Job, and a MongoDB user-creation Job. Hooks are install-only (never re-run destructively on upgrade), configmaps are namespaced, and AUTO_INCREMENT sequences are advanced with valid setval-style calls so seeded rows never collide with runtime inserts.

concepts.name: Demo Baseline and Pre-Demo Gate
concepts.summary: Helm-owned demo/initial-delivery baseline for customer-facing demo environments: sync and check SQL scripts plus a manifest, wrapped by a one-command gate script (demo-baseline-gate.sh all) that verifies demo readiness against a deployed environment before a customer demo.

concepts.name: SOPS+age Test-Credential Store and Keycloak Seeding
concepts.summary: Central, encrypted-in-git store of dev/pre-dev test-user credentials (SOPS + age) readable by humans and agents. seed-keycloak-users.sh creates users via the Keycloak Admin API — no CONFIGURE_TOTP required action, so seeded users bypass interactive 2FA — supports Keycloak user attributes, and writes created credentials back into the store. Production credentials are explicitly excluded.

concepts.name: Optional SigNoz Observability Stack
concepts.summary: SigNoz (with vendored ClickHouse/Zookeeper/Postgres/Redpanda subcharts) is an optional dependency gated by signoz.enabled. Enabling it auto-points backend services at the in-cluster OTLP HTTP collector via helper templates; the UI is served at /signoz on the main domain (bare /signoz redirects to /signoz/). Prod telemetry stays off by default and a KDG-safe pseudonymization flag (telemetryPseudonymizationEnabled) is built but also off pending sign-off.

concepts.name: Render Guard Test Suite
concepts.summary: A Python/bash test layer under tests/ renders the chart (or minimal sub-charts) with helm template and asserts security and operational invariants: statistics HMAC secret required, password-reset/account-invite URLs wired, OTP admin client present, storage classes preserved on upgrade, value-driven image pull policy, Redis-backed availability + Matrix room encryption gates, MatrixRTC call-cutover security, and no legacy chat. guardrail_selftest.sh proves the ADR-005 scanner can actually fail.

concepts.name: Global Support Access (ADR-018) Gate
concepts.summary: Support access (a Global Support Admin helping one consultant in a fresh encrypted 1:1 Matrix room after a live handshake, auto-withdrawn after at most four hours) ships disabled in every environment (userService.supportAccess.enabled=false). The flag gates only new handshakes; enabling it requires a Keycloak realm-role script and migration checks documented in the runbook.

concepts.name: Chart Release Workflow
concepts.summary: Manual workflow_dispatch GitHub Actions workflow (run from main) that tags the release, packages the umbrella chart, and publishes it as an OCI artifact to ghcr.io/openresilienceinitiative/charts. Environment overlay values are excluded from the platform release package.

flows.name: Deploy Platform
flows.summary: Copy values.yaml.default and secrets.yaml.default to local gitignored files and fill in domain/realm/credentials → helm upgrade --install with -f values.yaml -f values-<env>.yaml [-f digest-overlay] -f secrets.yaml --wait-for-jobs → subcharts provision Keycloak (realm + theme), MariaDB (schema mirrors), MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Redis, Matrix, LiveKit/MatrixRTC, Element Call, ingress → install-only bootstrap jobs seed tenants, topics, Keycloak and Mongo users.

flows.name: MatrixRTC Token Bootstrap
flows.summary: helm install renders matrixrtc-auth-secrets and livekit-config from ignored secrets → the matrixrtc-bootstrap-token Job waits for Synapse, registers or reuses the non-admin membership-reader user, logs in, and patches the real Matrix access token into matrixrtc-auth-secrets → MatrixRTC auth waits for the token, then LiveKit, MatrixRTC auth, and Element Call start without a second bootstrap step → at call time the policy gateway resolves every new call/reconnect against UserService (callPolicyToken, fail-closed) before a LiveKit grant is issued.

flows.name: Cutover Release (digest-pinned)
flows.summary: Cross-repo release manifest reaches ready-for-predev with reviewed digests, security evidence and rotated secrets → scripts/cutover-release-preflight.py validates it fail-closed and writes the digest overlay values file → helm upgrade --install with the overlay between environment values and secrets → render guards and the runbook's post-deploy checks confirm no legacy artifacts and no leaked credentials.

flows.name: Demo Baseline Gate
flows.summary: Before a customer demo: DEMO_BASE_URL=<env> ./scripts/demo-baseline-gate.sh all → syncs the Helm-owned baseline into MariaDB (demo-baseline-sync.sql), checks invariants (demo-baseline-check.sql, manifest.json), and probes the deployed APIs → pass/fail demo readiness.

flows.name: Seed Test Users
flows.summary: scripts/seed-keycloak-users.sh decrypts the SOPS+age test-user store → creates users through the Keycloak Admin API (no CONFIGURE_TOTP required action, optional user attributes) → writes generated credentials back into the encrypted store so humans and agents share one source of test logins.

flows.name: Release Chart
flows.summary: Maintainer triggers the release workflow from main with a version input → workflow creates and pushes the Git tag, packages the umbrella chart, and publishes it as an OCI chart to ghcr.io/openresilienceinitiative/charts.
